name: Quick Reset & Hold Checkpoints
description: R - instant new attempt. Hold Z in practice mode - checkpoints with no delay.

quick-reset.name: Quick Reset (R)
quick-reset.description: Press <cy>R</c> to instantly start a new attempt (works during the death animation too).

practice-reset-from-start.name: R in practice: from the start
practice-reset-from-start.description: Off: <cy>R</c> goes back to the last checkpoint. On: <cy>R</c> restarts the whole level.

hold-checkpoints.name: Hold Z for checkpoints
hold-checkpoints.description: In practice mode, <cy>holding Z</c> keeps placing checkpoints.

checkpoint-interval.name: Checkpoint interval (sec)
checkpoint-interval.description: Delay between checkpoints while Z is held. <cy>0</c> = a checkpoint every frame (no delay).
